School Schedule

Fall no-school days, straight from the district calendar

Labor Day, Indigenous Peoples and Immigrants Day, the conference Friday, Election Day, Veterans Day, and Thanksgiving.

Posted Sep 27, 2026, 7:05 AM · Updated Nov 6, 2026, 10:49 AM

Mark these from the official 2026–27 District 60 calendar:

  • Mon, Sep 7 Labor Day
  • Mon, Oct 12 Indigenous Peoples and Immigrants Day
  • Wed–Thu, Oct 21–22 Parent-teacher conferences in the evening (school is in session)
  • Fri, Oct 23 Schools closed
  • Tue, Nov 3 Election Day
  • Wed, Nov 11 Veterans Day
  • Wed–Fri, Nov 25–27 Thanksgiving recess

Winter break runs December 21 through January 1. January 4 is a records day, so students return Tuesday, January 5. Official district calendars
